info.description: Resets scores for the leaderboards with the given IDs for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console. Only draft leaderboards may be reset.
info.title: Google Play Game Management

requests.description: Resets all achievements for the currently authenticated player for your application. This method is only accessible to whitelisted tester accounts for your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/achievements/reset

requests.description: Resets all draft achievements for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/achievements/resetAllForAllPlayers

requests.description: Resets achievements with the given IDs for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console. Only draft achievements may be reset.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/achievements/resetMultipleForAllPlayers

requests.description: Resets the achievement with the given ID for the currently authenticated player. This method is only accessible to whitelisted tester accounts for your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/achievements/{achievementId}/reset
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resets the achievement with the given ID for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console. Only draft achievements can be reset.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/achievements/{achievementId}/resetForAllPlayers
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get the list of players hidden from the given application. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console.
requests.name: GET /games/v1management/applications/{applicationId}/players/hidden
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Unhide the given player's leaderboard scores from the given application. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console.
requests.name: DELETE /games/v1management/applications/{applicationId}/players/hidden/{playerId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Hide the given player's leaderboard scores from the given application. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/applications/{applicationId}/players/hidden/{playerId}
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resets all player progress on all events for the currently authenticated player. This method is only accessible to whitelisted tester accounts for your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/events/reset

requests.description: Resets all draft events for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/events/resetAllForAllPlayers

requests.description: Resets events with the given IDs for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console. Only draft events may be reset.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/events/resetMultipleForAllPlayers

requests.description: Resets all player progress on the event with the given ID for the currently authenticated player. This method is only accessible to whitelisted tester accounts for your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/events/{eventId}/reset
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resets the event with the given ID for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console. Only draft events can be reset.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/events/{eventId}/resetForAllPlayers
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resets scores for the leaderboard with the given ID for the currently authenticated player. This method is only accessible to whitelisted tester accounts for your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}/scores/reset
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resets scores for the leaderboard with the given ID for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console. Only draft leaderboards can be reset.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/leaderboards/{leaderboardId}/scores/resetForAllPlayers
requests.note: Replace {{GOOGLE_PLAY_GAME_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Resets all scores for all leaderboards for the currently authenticated players. This method is only accessible to whitelisted tester accounts for your application.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/scores/reset

requests.description: Resets scores for all draft leaderboards for all players. This method is only available to user accounts for your developer console.
requests.name: POST /games/v1management/scores/resetAllForAllPlayers
